name: user-simulation
description: Run synthetic users over a live web app and get step-by-step UX reports (action, clarity, doubt, emotion). Two modes: run (custom — you know which user to test: your profile, URL and task) and autopilot (inferred — from just a URL it infers who likely uses the site, you choose which ones to run, it consolidates the findings). Drives the browser via Playwright MCP.
